summary: Frontend-only regression check of the build/perf refactor (runtime-fetched i18n locales, root Suspense BootSpinner, lazy marketing routes, lazy App.js widgets, lazy Cmd/Ctrl-K palette). Everything requested works and the console showed no errors: no 'A component suspended', no ChunkLoadError, no pageerrors.

issues: Cookie consent banner (data-testid cookie-consent-banner, z-[60]) sits on top of the bottom-right UnifiedAssistant FAB (unified-assistant-toggle) and blocks clicks until cookies are accepted or declined. This existed before the refactor.

A light-blue banner about 50px tall directly under the sub-nav shows no readable text (faint text appears only briefly). Likely a rotating or empty tip banner. Not related to the refactor; worth a look.

action_items: Optional: offset the UnifiedAssistant FAB, or lift it above the cookie banner, while the cookie banner is visible
Optional: check the empty light-blue banner on /dashboard Start tab
critical_code_review_comments: i18n PublicLocalesBackend fetch has no cache-busting/version query; after a deploy that changes locale keys, browsers/CDN may serve stale /locales/*.json. Consider appending a build hash (e.g. ?v=process.env.REACT_APP_BUILD_ID).

When the user's server-side profile language is set (App.js ~L333-337), it overrides a localStorage i18nextLng preset after login. This is by design, but the DE preset only shows on public pages for users with a saved EN profile.
GlobalCommandPalette unmounts the palette while closed (fine). The first Ctrl+K press fetches the chunk and opened correctly within 1.2s.
